appearances.snippet: I do have to say today is a great day to be Candace Owens. It's a great day also to be a Candace Owens podcast listener, because back in November, I was telling you guys that France was, in fact, involved in Charlie Kirk's assassination, specifically that their intelligence agency, also known as DGSE, was involved.

verification.notes: Live searches of current court coverage, French official material, and reporting found no evidence connecting France or DGSE to Charlie Kirk's assassination. The public case instead charges Tyler Robinson, who remains presumed innocent. No conclusive source supports this foreign-state allegation.

records.text: The defendants included four DGSE officers, three police officers, six executives, a security guard, a doctor, and an engineer.
